summary: Implemented bounded versioned inert job identities, logical state snapshots, immutable attempt diagnostics and output references, with pure correlated transitions and input-free admission errors.
API: job_records: admit, serialize, transition, JobSpec, InputRef, Configuration, JobState, Attempt, OutputRef and RecordError; documented in docs/parallel/job-records-api.md.

limitations: Synthetic local evidence only. Caller-supplied digests and verification availability are assertions, not proof or authentication. Full-history attempt-ID uniqueness requires caller enforcement. No cache decision, worker execution, ownership, output publication, restart reconciliation, real qualification, canonical integration or CLI is implemented. Objective 010 and architecture assessment remain.
